title: External memory: history, profile and conversation state

videos.script: A support chat is not a list of questions. It is one customer, telling a story over twelve messages. {{alone}} Answer each message on its own, and two of Beatriz's questions are refused: one says Mansfield Park without saying why, and one asks for her order number. {{history}} Send the whole conversation again every turn, and the prompt grows with every message. Twelve turns cost four thousand six hundred tokens, and the order number is still not found. {{rewrite}} The usual fix is to rewrite the question so it stands on its own. Here the earlier turn most like the new one is put in front of it, for the search only. {{table}} Every turn goes into a table, with the account it belongs to. {{state}} And what the program knows for certain, the customer's name and order number, is written as a source the reply can cite. {{accounts}} Leave the account out of one query, and Rafael is told Beatriz's order number. {{forget}} A memory of a customer is personal data. It needs an owner, a reason, and a way to be erased in one statement. {{end}}
